subject.title: feat(mxc): add Windows MXC sandbox backend

question: After the full-mode registration bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept `@microsoft/mxc-sdk@0.7.0` with its native `node-pty` dependency/build allowance and argv-carried base64 config for this prerelease external sandbox plugin?
rationale: The remaining code bug is mechanical, but the native dependency and argv transport are a sandbox/security boundary choice that automation should not approve implicitly.

options.title: Fix guard and approve boundary
options.body: Require the MXC full-mode guard/test repair, then let maintainer/security approval unblock the native SDK and argv transport for this prerelease plugin.

options.title: Pause for a different SDK boundary
options.body: Hold the PR until MXC exposes a non-argv config transport or maintainers choose a stricter native dependency policy.

recommendation.title: Fix guard and approve boundary
recommendation.body: Require the MXC full-mode guard/test repair, then let maintainer/security approval unblock the native SDK and argv transport for this prerelease plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The sandbox backend history points to this owner as the best available route for deciding whether the new Windows sandbox boundary fits OpenClaw.
